datasets.title: NGC 2392 in the infrared
datasets.description: ESA/Webb's picture of NGC 2392, NIRCam at 1.15, 1.87, 2.12 and 3.35 µm with MIRI at 10 µm: ionised hydrogen in the bubble, dust and clumps of molecular hydrogen in the shell around it. It lies on the walls the nebula's spectra give, as Hubble's photograph does: a fast inner bubble inside a round outer shell (García-Díaz et al. 2012), each measured feature on the side its speed gives (García-Díaz et al. 2015). No speed is measured in this light.
datasets.summary: Webb's infrared picture on the same walls: the bubble's ionised gas, and the dust and molecular hydrogen around it.
